about: Hand-written expectations for #54 (tools/qualify_one_screen.py and tests/test_issue54_one_screen.py). Invented incidents with long activity names and a long file name; Desk is an invented context column. Never read by product code.

activities.A: Received through the customer service portal and registered for triage
activities.B: Assigned to the second-level application support group for analysis
activities.C: Waiting for the requesting customer to supply missing information
activities.D: Resolved by the application support group
activities.E: Closed after the requester confirmed the resolution

steps.choice: Keep incidents that end with it
